name: Shenzhen Topband Co., Ltd.
summary: Topband's principal business is the research, development, production and sale of intelligent control system solutions. Its core technologies combine electronic control, motors, batteries, power supplies and an Internet of Things platform. It provides leading customized intelligent control solutions for four industries: home appliances, tools, new energy and industrial applications.
